annotations.text:
Lilo — light, on Liquid Glass, holiday only.

No money in it. Costs, splitting and settling belong to Dutchii, so the kitty and settle-up screens are gone and nothing here does arithmetic. What that frees up is the part a holiday app is actually for: what is booked, what is still open, and what a given day holds.

On Grok Bot: you are right that it is a separate app, and I cannot get to it. mobbin.com is blocked by this session's network policy so the link will not open, and every search — including the bare string "Grok Bot" — returns screens whose app name is Grok. Rather than guess, nothing here claims to come from it. Send me two or three screenshots and I will fold it in properly.

Bond verified 8 for 8, and it earns two screens. Stories run across the top of a trip, captured while it is happening. Memories turns finished trips into the source of the next one's suggestions — Bond's Discover card, reading "you have walked three coast paths now, here is the one above Lisbon", with the persistent ask-your-memories pill and its counter.

iOS 26 Liquid Glass throughout: nav as separate floating capsules rather than a bar, a tab bar that floats beside its own add button, glass tiles and composers, two variants only, concentric radii. Content stays flat and opaque so the chrome is the only thing that floats.

The two Bond screens. A story is captured during the trip; memories are what is left afterwards, and they feed the next trip rather than sitting in an archive. Lilo already had a Memories tab with nothing behind it.
Filing a confirmation goes from nine steps to three. Getting a yes from four people moves inside the app. And a day stops being four tabs to reconcile in your head.
Gestures are shortcuts for repeated actions. Cancelling a trip and removing someone from it keep their buttons — anything a toast cannot undo should cost a deliberate tap.
